usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect the LVM logical volume backing a specific Ceph OSD on a given node — useful when diagnosing OSD placement, verifying block/db/wal device layout, or auditing LV sizes after disk replacements. The `type` parameter selects which device component to inspect (block data device by default; use `db` or `wal` when those are on separate LVs). The node must be online and the OSD must exist on that node; querying a node that does not host the specified OSD will return an error.

examples.summary: Get block device LV info for OSD 3 on node pve1

tips: Omitting `type` defaults to `block`, which is the primary data device — always specify `db` or `wal` explicitly if you have bluestore metadata on separate LVs.
The returned `lv_size` is in bytes; divide by 1073741824 for GiB.
Cross-reference `vg_name` and `lv_path` against `pvs`/`vgs` output on the node to confirm the underlying physical disk for the OSD.
Requires `Sys.Audit` at the root path — API tokens scoped below root will be denied.
